A1.justification: Both PDFs contain the same research work, with complete readable text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A-G. Pages 4-28 are identical in extracted text and rendered appearance.

before.justification: v2 reports original MNIST, CIFAR10, and synthetic-data experiments in Section 6, plus robust-memorization and loss-landscape analyses in Appendices A-B.

after.justification: v3 retains the original experimental results in Section 6, Tables 1-2, Figure 2, and the additional empirical analyses in Appendices A-B.

M1.justification: The classifier construction, two-layer convolutional network, adversarial loss, perturbation constraints, and training algorithm in Sections 4-5 are unchanged.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same MNIST, CIFAR10, and synthetic structured-data coverage, including the same appendix evaluation scenarios.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons in Section 6 and Appendices A-B are identical. No evaluated comparison method is added, removed, or revised.

E3.justification: Model sizes, training epochs, perturbation radii, synthetic-data parameters, and evaluation procedures are unchanged. The parenthesis correction in Definition 3.1 does not change the clean-error metric.

E4.justification: The model-capacity and feature-learning analyses in Section 6 and the robust-memorization, local-flatness, and global-flatness analyses in Appendices A-B are retained without modification.

E5.justification: Empirical averaging and reporting practices are unchanged. Neither version reports repeated-run counts, seeds, confidence intervals, or significance tests for these experiments.

E6.justification: Tables 1-2, Figures 1-4, and their reported findings are unchanged. For example, Table 2 retains synthetic-data clean and robust test accuracies of 98.5 and 17.5, respectively.

T1.justification: v3 adds the missing closing parenthesis after f(X) in Definition 3.1. This repairs typesetting without substantively changing the definition; assumptions, theorems, derivations, and appendix proofs are otherwise identical.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction contributions, and conclusion retain the same claims about representation complexity, robust memorization, and three-stage training dynamics explaining CGRO.

C2.justification: Interpretations involving partial true-feature learning, noise memorization, and local versus global flatness are unchanged, as are qualifications concerning structured data and hyperparameter assumptions.

D1.justification: Architecture details, hyperparameters, training budgets, RTX 4090 hardware disclosure, and appendix implementation information are identical. No code or data access information is added or revised.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, and positioning relative to prior research are unchanged. The added ICLR workshop notice identifies the publication venue rather than changing research positioning.

P1.justification: v3 adds an ICLR 2024 workshop and copyright notice, updates the arXiv version/date stamp, and repairs the parenthesis in Definition 3.1. Scientific prose and section organization remain unchanged.

P2.justification: The added first-page notice causes limited introduction text reflow across columns and onto page 2. All figures, tables, captions, and appendix layouts remain unchanged.

improvement.justification: v3 supplies publication information and fixes a minor typographical defect in Definition 3.1. These provide negligible editorial polish; the scientific arguments, empirical evidence, explanations, and reproducibility information remain unchanged throughout the paper and appendices.
